summary: A character of known weight and tame part evaluates on det of K₀ through its tame part modulo 𝔪.

steps.claim: By its weight (gridChar_hasWeight), gridChar at det(1, k), k ∈ K₀, is the character of the tame part modulo 𝔪 at det(k mod 𝔪) (apply_det_eq_charOfTamePart), provided the tame part is trivial outside the places of 𝔪.
The tame part (ω_wψ_{ϑ,w})^{l+1} or ω_w^{l+1} is trivial outside the chosen places and Q(ϑ), which are the places of 𝔪 = gridModulus(ϑ) (cases on c).
steps.lean:
cases c <;> simp +contextual [places_modulus_eq_union, liftTamePart, TameChar.pow, ϑ.1.1.5]
  tauto) _
